scope: Prepare evidence for the outstanding Windows and screen-reader distribution gates after Product review of M1.2. This is proposed follow-up work, not approval to execute, release or spend.
deliverables: A clean Windows acceptance record for the portable application.
A keyboard and screen-reader qualification record tied to that candidate.

security_restrictions: No execution, repository mutation, AI providers, credentials, paid requests, release, merge or deployment is authorised by importing this plan.

milestones.deliverable: Record clean Windows acceptance and signing status

acceptance.tests: Record extraction, launch, native read confirmation, genuine pinned import, cancellation, offline reopen and removal on a clean supported Windows 11 x64 machine without developer tools.
acceptance.security: Keep unsigned/signing status explicit. Do not bypass SmartScreen, organisation policy, sandboxing or certificate verification. No public distribution before all gates are accepted.

milestones.deliverable: Qualify keyboard and screen-reader planning journeys

acceptance.tests: Record keyboard-only and screen-reader results for source review, native confirmation, progress, cancellation, task dependencies, errors and saved-history recovery on the candidate tested in WINDOWS.
acceptance.security: Keep simulated demonstrations, real read-only proposals and unavailable execution distinguishable in accessible names. No approval or spending authority may be inferred.

tasks.instruction: After separate Product authorisation, perform clean-machine Windows acceptance for the M1.2 candidate and record the exact candidate hash, OS, prerequisites, results and unresolved signing gate in docs/acceptance/m1.2-windows.md. This import only proposes the work; it must not run or distribute anything.

After the WINDOWS evidence is available and separate Product authorisation is granted, qualify the same candidate with keyboard-only navigation and a Windows screen reader. Record observations, defects and remaining gates in docs/acceptance/m1.2-accessibility.md. This proposal grants no execution permission.
